harnesses.transport: interactive session over a local bridge inside the run sandbox

answer.reason: operator questions are deferred beyond D1

continue_session.reason: each submit opens a new session in D1

delegate.reason: agent-to-agent delegation is deferred beyond D1

placement.reason: D1 runs only on the core's own node

reconnect.reason: after a core restart D1 reports surviving runs from disk only

caveats: Each run works in its own clone of the repository inside its own sandbox, made from a git bundle of the commit recorded at submit, and its commits return only to its own runs/<run_id> branch. This is a sandbox clone per run, not a host worktree: no git worktree is created on the host, and the host checkout and index are never written.

harnesses.transport: interactive session over stdio inside the run sandbox

steer.reason: the session protocol has no in-turn user message

caveats: a tool's child process can survive until the sandbox is deleted
